source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Opening examples (ars-magica-core#044); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Structures (ars-magica-core#044); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Monasteries (ars-magica-core#044); licence Ars Magica Open License

note: Mendicant friar. class-or-role. A wandering religious brother takes vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience while traveling to preach and serve God. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Miracles (ars-magica-core#044); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Public Power for Women (ars-magica-core#044); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Paid Rights Virtue. feat-or-talent. This virtue marks a woman as exceptional in a society where women generally have fewer public rights. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Chapter 15, Story Ideas, Treasure Hunting: Treasures to Hunt (ars-magica-core#045); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie prince’s tears. other. A particular faerie prince’s tears of happiness contain raw vis. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Chapter 15, Story Ideas, Exploration: Places to Explore (ars-magica-core#045); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie palace’s story treasures. other. A shining queen turns especially beautiful stories into jewels or fine tapestries, whose collection can teach visitors much. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Chapter 15, Story Ideas, Exploration: Places to Explore (ars-magica-core#045); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Chapter 15, Story Ideas, Exploration: Places to Explore (ars-magica-core#045); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Chapter 15, Story Ideas, Exploration: Places to Explore (ars-magica-core#045); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Primus (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Horn of the Champions (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Societas Flambonis: The Milites (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Milites. class-or-role. These Flambeau magi follow a conduct code, support fellow sworn members, and serve the Order and its officials. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Code of Garus (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Code of Garus. other. Publicly swearing to this conduct code grants a Story Flaw, while taking it seriously may impose a separate Personality Flaw. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Societas Flambonis: The Cult of Mercury (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Flamen. class-or-role. A Mercurian magus who commonly leads rites, spends required vis, interprets omens, and officiates at Hermetic ceremonies. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Flambeau Concepts — Hoplites (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hoplites. class-or-role. These combat magi hunt outlawed wizards and may assist Quaesitores in dangerous investigations or arrests. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Flambeau Concepts — Crusaders (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Crusaders. class-or-role. These Flambeau magi fight non-Hermetic wizards and may recruit them, purge them, or clash over those choices. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Flambeau Concepts — Demon-Hunters and Exorcists (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Demon-Hunters and Exorcists. class-or-role. These magi investigate and combat demonic influence, often combining Intellego magic with mundane investigation and assistants. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Flambeau Concepts — Duelists and Champions (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Duelists and Champions. class-or-role. These magi may pledge to declare Wizard’s War against anyone who first declares it against their ally, or serve as certamen champions. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Flambeau Concepts — Mercenaries and Adventurers (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Mercenaries and Adventurers. class-or-role. These magi hire out their fighting abilities but may abandon a mission or change sides for a better offer. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Flambeau Concepts — Hunters and Dragon-Slayers (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hunters and Dragon-Slayers. class-or-role. These magi track supernatural quarry for sport, threats, vis, or ingredients, and some try to capture beasts alive. [verb sense; also needs ingredient-properties] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Flambeau Concepts — Outlaws and Rogues (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Outlaws and Rogues. class-or-role. These magi rob mundanes or wizards and use magic to evade capture. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The School of the Founder (ars-magica-houses#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: School of the Founder. class-or-role. This combat approach uses fire spells for strong, broad-purpose attacks, but is conspicuous and can be countered by fire resistance or Magic Resistance. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The School of Apromor (ars-magica-houses#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: School of Apromor. class-or-role. This approach uses Perdo magic to injure or disable opponents, bypass some defenses through indirect attacks, and conceal the caster more readily than fire magic. [verb remove; also needs conceal-or-sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The School of Boreas (ars-magica-houses#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: School of Boreas. class-or-role. This approach relies on Perdo Ignem for cold and darkness effects, avoiding fire’s collateral risk but offering a narrow range of attacks. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The School of Ramius (ars-magica-houses#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: School of Ramius. class-or-role. This approach combines mundane weapon attacks with magical defense and combat enhancement, avoiding reliance on penetrating an opponent’s Magic Resistance. [verb add; also needs power-interaction] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Schools of Magical Combat at a Glance (ars-magica-houses#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: School of Sebastian. class-or-role. This approach makes direct attacks with a Form other than Ignem and is associated with a Magical Focus. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Schools of Magical Combat at a Glance (ars-magica-houses#002); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Recommended Virtue: Magical Focus (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Schools of Sebastian. class-or-role. A family of combat traditions that conjure harmful substances or objects through non-Ignem Forms and commonly specialize around a Magical Focus. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Fighting Invisibly; Effects of Invisibility (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Mercurian Spell Mastery Abilities (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Disguised Casting. feat-or-talent. Lets the caster suppress or alter her sigil, and adds her Mastery score when others try to recognize a copied sigil. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Mercurian Spell Mastery Abilities (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: House Acclaim (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Rhaetian (ars-magica-houses#005); licence Ars Magica Open License

note: Envied Beauty. feat-or-talent. The character’s beauty provokes jealousy and revulsion in some vain people of the same gender, though concealment can avoid the penalties at its own cost. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Leagues — The Daughters of Echo (ars-magica-houses#005); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Leagues — The Gastronomers (ars-magica-houses#005); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Leagues — The Keepers of the Pearl of Great Price (ars-magica-houses#005); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Leagues — The Humble Brethren (ars-magica-houses#005); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Leagues — The Silent Ones (ars-magica-houses#005); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Leagues — The Single Ocean (ars-magica-houses#005); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Single Ocean. class-or-role. This league explores Levantine and North African cities and seeks peaceful relations with Jewish and Muslim sorcerers. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Leagues — The Viticulturalists (ars-magica-houses#005); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Invocation of the Civic Patron (ars-magica-houses#006); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Beloved Rivals (ars-magica-houses#008); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Eristic Moots (ars-magica-houses#008); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Eristic Moot. ritual-or-art. A witnessed public contest in which participants agree in advance on permitted forms of conflict, with at least five people present. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Apprentice’s Gauntlet (ars-magica-houses#008); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Excerpts from the Book of Instruction (ars-magica-houses#008); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Cabals (ars-magica-houses#008); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Cabal. class-or-role. A group of Tytali coordinating schemes toward a shared goal, typically meeting anonymously and assigning tasks by consensus. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Current Cabals (ars-magica-houses#008); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Cabal of the Broken Ocean. other. A covert group that supports Lithuanian pagans against the Teutonic Knights. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Current Cabals (ars-magica-houses#008); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Cabal of Erigone. other. A group seeking to prevent Caecilius of Durenmar from becoming praeco of the Rhine Tribunal. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Current Cabals (ars-magica-houses#008); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Cabal of the Lance. other. A covert group shielding a newly formed covenant from tribunal intrigue for an unclear purpose. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Current Cabals (ars-magica-houses#008); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Cabal of the Shining Eye. other. A group working to maneuver the Roman Tribunal into colonizing North Africa. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues: Leper Magus (ars-magica-houses#009); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Persona (ars-magica-houses#010); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Flaws — Leprosy (ars-magica-houses#010); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Leprosy. condition. Permanently reduces Living Conditions by 2, or by 3 in a leper colony; each Aging Crisis also causes a Heavy Wound, and the character cannot gain a positive Reputation. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Flaws — Beloved Rival (ars-magica-houses#010); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Titanoi (ars-magica-houses#010); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Titanoi. class-or-role. A spirit-focused Mystery Cult whose members gain a Major Magical Focus in naturally insubstantial supernatural entities and are taught Magic Lore and Titanoi Cult Lore. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Leper Magi (ars-magica-houses#010); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Infernal Taint (ars-magica-houses#010); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ars Goetia. other. A spirit-working tradition that summons, weakens, binds, commands, and punishes non-Divine spiritual entities, but carries social and supernatural taint. [verb bind; also needs soul-binding] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Corpus Guidelines (ars-magica-houses#010); licence Ars Magica Open License

This tradition specializes in summoning and commanding a particular group of wild animals, and its members are trained with Animal Ken and a matching minor focus but cannot transform into or harm animals. [verb none; also needs creature-control] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Traditions of House Ex Miscellanea — Hermetic Haruspexes (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hermetic Haruspexes. class-or-role. Members practice omen-reading by inspecting the entrails of sacrificed animals and are unusually susceptible to Twilight. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Traditions of House Ex Miscellanea — Karaites (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Karaites. class-or-role. These practitioners frame their magic as holy effects directly from God and reject other magi casting spells upon them. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Traditions of House Ex Miscellanea — Malocchi (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Malocchi. class-or-role. These practitioners use eye-contact-based Entrancement and are feared as bringers of bad luck, while their magic is weakened when someone stands on their shadow. [verb bind; also needs luck-mechanism] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Traditions of House Ex Miscellanea — Scinnfolk (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Scinnfolk. class-or-role. These Gifted folk healers and charm-workers pass on eclectic natural magic and faerie charms, with Fertility as their characteristic supernatural gift. [verb alter; also needs plant-or-creature-target] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Traditions of House Ex Miscellanea — Tempestaria (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Tempestaria. class-or-role. These weather witches summon winds and other weather beyond ordinary Hermetic capability, using simple sympathetic tools as a required condition. [verb law: create; also needs vow-cost] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Traditions of House Ex Miscellanea — Witches of Thessaly (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Witches of Thessaly. class-or-role. These practitioners use summoning and curses, and some can travel between portals into Faerie regions and their mountain caves. [verb law: summon; also needs world-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ringing the Changes (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Koldun. class-or-role. These Novgorod shamans have turned from pagan priesthood to sorcery, following the Thessalian model. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ringing the Changes (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Trollsynir. class-or-role. These northern wizards claim giant ancestry and possess the power to curse their enemies, following the Damhadh-Duidsan model. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ringing the Changes (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Corrguineach. class-or-role. This Irish tradition controls elemental spirits and allied with Flambeau against House Diedne. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ringing the Changes (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Breton bards of Melusine blood. class-or-role. These former Diedne practitioners use harp music to enchant others. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ringing the Changes (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Roman necromancers. class-or-role. These practitioners command spirits to terrorize locals and gain power. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ringing the Changes (ars-magica-houses#011); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Taltos. class-or-role. These Magyar herb-workers use their knowledge to improve physical and martial abilities, heal, and sometimes take the shape of a white horse. [verb transform; also needs form-transformation] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Minor Hermetic Virtue: Ring/Circle Magic (ars-magica-houses#012); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ring/Circle Magic. feat-or-talent. Lets Columbae cast eligible Touch, Ring, Circle spells with faster circle drawing and special boundary-marking options. [verb alter; also needs formation-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Donatores Requietis Aeternae (ars-magica-houses#012); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Donatores Requietis Aeternae. class-or-role. A religiously oriented magus tradition devoted to helping the dead pass on and combating dangerous restless spirits. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtue: Banishing (ars-magica-houses#012); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Banishing. power. Expels creatures with Might from a specified area and makes their return painful and difficult for a limited time. [verb move; also needs protection-field, power-interaction] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Favored Virtues and Flaws (ars-magica-houses#012); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Restriction (consecrated ground). condition. Prevents Donatores from casting spells on consecrated ground. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Cult of Orpheus (ars-magica-houses#012); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Cult of Orpheus. class-or-role. A mystery cult whose magi use Hermetic magic expanded by personal emotional connections to others. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Cult of Orpheus — Key Facts; Characters (ars-magica-houses#012); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sanguine Humour’s Blessing. power. A major virtue that defines the Orphic magoi, though this passage does not specify its mechanical effect. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Cult of Orpheus — Key Facts; Characters (ars-magica-houses#012); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Orphic Magic. feat-or-talent. A minor Hermetic virtue that expands Orphic magoi’s capabilities through their tradition’s older magical knowledge. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Cult of Orpheus — Key Facts (ars-magica-houses#012); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Restriction (True Feeling). condition. A major Hermetic flaw associated with the Orphic magoi and their emotional connections; its specific mechanical effect is not given here. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Path of Orpheus (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Path of Orpheus ritual. ritual-or-art. A costly rite attempts to bring a dead person back by sending its leader into an Underworld-like realm to face Hades. [verb release; also needs revival-on-death, spirit-contract-judgement] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Major General Virtue, Sanguine Humor’s Blessing (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sanguine Humor’s Blessing. feat-or-talent. Emotional ties represented by an appropriate Story Flaw provide bonuses to relevant Ability or spellcasting rolls. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Pharmacopoeians (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Pharmacopoeians. class-or-role. A healing-focused tradition whose members use plant, animal, and mineral lore and are committed to preserving life. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Major Supernatural Virtue: Mythic Herbalism (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Mythic Herbalism. feat-or-talent. Enables brewing remedies, poisons, and temporary physical-bonus potions using natural ingredients and an Ability test. [verb transform; also needs item-bound-power] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Minor Hermetic Virtue: Root-Cutter (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Root-Cutter. feat-or-talent. Lets a magus prepare natural magical ingredients that reduce the vis cost of healing Rituals, subject to a half-cost cap. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Lineage of Pralix (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Lineage of Pralix. class-or-role. A Hermetic lineage that studies exotic magic and helps hedge traditions join the Order. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Major Supernatural Virtue: Comprehend Magic (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Comprehend Magic. feat-or-talent. Grants the Comprehend Magic Ability for examining active magic without the Magic Resistance penalty associated with the lesser sensitivity it surpasses. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Supernatural Ability: Comprehend Magic (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Comprehend Magic Ability. other. Analyzes magic’s presence, type, approximate function, and magnitude through progressively longer scrutiny, and can improve certain Vim spells against the studied subject. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Spell Guideline (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Rego Vim spell guideline. other. Can sustain or suppress another caster’s spells of a specified type up to the Vim spell’s level plus two magnitudes, targeting the spell or its caster. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Mastery Special Ability: Unraveling (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Unraveling. feat-or-talent. Adds three times the Mastery score to a Perdo Vim spell’s effective level when checking whether it can destroy magic. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Rustic Magi (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Rustic Magi. class-or-role. Rural folk magicians who craft spells and enchanted devices from ordinary objects and share their effects with local communities. [verb transform; also needs item-bound-power] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Profession Apothecary (ars-magica-houses#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Profession Apothecary. other. Identifies, cultivates, and prepares common medicinal ingredients, reducing penalties to Medicine rolls when remedies are otherwise inadequate. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Characters — Major Supernatural Virtue: Craft Magic (ars-magica-houses#014); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Craft Magic. feat-or-talent. Lets a character use craft work to deliver powers, gain capped craft bonuses, make charged items, and create vis-based lesser enchantments. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Minor Hermetic Virtue: Spell Foci (ars-magica-houses#014); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Spell Foci. feat-or-talent. Lets a caster use one required, effect-appropriate object property as a capped Casting Total bonus. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Hermetic Sahirs — Major Supernatural Virtue: Sihr (ars-magica-houses#014); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sihr. feat-or-talent. A supernatural ability used to assess, summon, and bargain with jinn for service. [verb law: summon; also needs spirit-contract-judgement] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Siren Song (ars-magica-houses#015); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Siren Song. power. Music lets the user command listeners who fail to resist, controlling them while the performance continues. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Characters (ars-magica-houses#015); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Minor Magical Focus (Mentem — an emotion). feat-or-talent. A Seirene’s focused Mentem magic specializes in one emotion, which can be chosen to match or oppose her personality. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Optional Rule: Continuous Research (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Continuous Research. feat-or-talent. Uninterrupted seasonal work on one laboratory project builds a modifier that increases Lab Total at five and 15 seasons. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: House Acclaim: Status in House Bonisagus (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: House Acclaim. other. A public-research Reputation that advances Bonisagus magi through four ranks and can affect House social dealings and apprentice searches. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Types of Magi Bonisagi (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Traditionalist. other. A Magic Theory specialization that adds 1 to the score when research attempts to break a Hermetic Limit. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Types of Magi Bonisagi (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Dabbler. other. A Magic Theory specialization applicable when inventing a spell or effect with a nonstandard Range, Duration, or Target. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Types of Magi Bonisagi (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Harmonizer. other. A Magic Theory specialization applicable when inventing spells or enchanting items that imitate supernatural abilities. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Magi Bonisagi apprentices (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Theoretical Interview. other. A day-long oral gauntlet examining an apprentice’s understanding of Magic Theory and the Arts rather than spellcasting. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Magi Bonisagi apprentices (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Trianomae solo journey gauntlet. other. A trained apprentice must travel alone to a distant covenant to prove they can survive independent travel before being proclaimed a magus. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Fostering (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Fosterage. other. Two Bonisagus magi exchange apprentices so each spends a year teaching Abilities and a later year assisting in the other’s laboratory. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Cipher of Trianoma (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Trianoma’s cipher. other. A variable shorthand used to hide political messages in notes, books, or Lab Text margins, with prior decoding improving later attempts. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Breakthroughs (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Minor Breakthrough. other. A discovery immediately usable and teachable within existing Hermetic magic, such as a new spell Range or Duration. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Breakthroughs (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Major Breakthrough. other. A discovery that extends Magic Theory without breaking its limits, such as a teachable Hermetic Virtue or variable application of an established idea. [verb transform; also needs power-granting] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Breakthroughs (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hermetic Breakthrough. other. A discovery that creates a new Arcane Ability or breaks a Lesser Limit of Hermetic magic. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues and Flaws: Minor Hermetic Virtues (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Colens Arcanorum. feat-or-talent. A House Bonisagus collector who begins at cannophori rank, receives research submissions for seven years, and helps select and compile a folio. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues and Flaws: Minor Hermetic Virtues (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Tenens Occultorum. feat-or-talent. A member chosen by the Primus for one of four secret-knowledge offices, with the specific position depending on experience. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues and Flaws: Minor Supernatural Virtue (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Figurine Magic. ritual-or-art. An Ability for making small wax or wood figurines whose powers provide benefits to the maker or others. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues and Flaws: Minor General Virtue (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Linguist. feat-or-talent. Increases Language Study Totals and character-generation experience in both living and dead languages by one quarter. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues and Flaws: Minor Personality Flaw (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Seeker. class-or-role. A member of a loose competitive group who devotes much of their life to finding ancient magic and arcane artifacts. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues and Flaws: Minor Story Flaw (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: House Acclaim Points and Score (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Boukoloi. other. The first Bonisagus Acclaim rank, reached at 5 Acclaim points. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: House Acclaim Points and Score (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Daduchos. other. The second Bonisagus Acclaim rank, reached at 15 Acclaim points. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: House Acclaim Points and Score (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Cannophori. other. The third Bonisagus Acclaim rank, reached at 30 Acclaim points. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: House Acclaim Points and Score (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Dendrophori. other. The fourth Bonisagus Acclaim rank, reached at 50 Acclaim points. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: House Acclaim Points and Score (ars-magica-houses#017); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Primus. other. The House leader stands above the four ordinary Bonisagus Acclaim ranks. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Arma Magica (ars-magica-houses#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Arma Magica. ritual-or-art. A family of Parma techniques folds the protective field into distinct defensive uses, with each fold treated as a Major Breakthrough. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Parma Magica Folds (ars-magica-houses#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Parma Ablativa. feat-or-talent. It doubles the Parma score for resistance, but each resisted effect’s Penetration reduces that resistance until it reaches zero. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Parma Magica Folds (ars-magica-houses#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Parma Absorbea. feat-or-talent. It halves the Parma score for resistance and holds a resisted spell for one combat round so its Penetration can boost the next spell’s casting total. [verb copy; also needs power-interaction] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Parma Magica Folds (ars-magica-houses#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Parma Condensa. feat-or-talent. It doubles resistance against one chosen Form and halves it against all other Forms. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Parma Magica Folds (ars-magica-houses#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Parma Custodia. feat-or-talent. It adds twice the Parma score to combat Defense against physical attacks, but provides no resistance against magic. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Parma Magica Folds (ars-magica-houses#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Parma Repercussa. feat-or-talent. It halves the Parma score for resistance and redirects a spell it stops toward a visible target, preserving the spell’s Penetration. [verb move; also needs power-interaction] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Parma Magica Folds (ars-magica-houses#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Parma Restricta. feat-or-talent. It surrounds a touched target with a protective mantle that also forces the target’s spells of greater than Personal range to penetrate the caster’s resistance. [verb block; also needs containment-rule] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Forfeit Immunity (ars-magica-houses#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Forfeit immunity. condition. A magus who is committing, preparing, or has recently committed a crime may lose some or all legal protection against proportionate action. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Wizard War (ars-magica-houses#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wizard War. condition. After a formal declaration and a lunar month of preparation, two magi may attack one another for a lunar month without prosecution for those attacks, subject to limits on collateral harm and shared property. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Domus Magna (ars-magica-houses#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Aegis of the Hearth. ritual-or-art. A defensive ritual protects Magvillus and its underground chambers, though the fortress’s exact ritual strength is secret and the protection is suppressed for two hours before sunrise on Good Friday. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Proxy Voting (ars-magica-houses#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Directed proxy. other. A sigil owner gives a proxy voter specific voting instructions that the proxy must follow. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Proxy Voting (ars-magica-houses#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Free proxy. other. A sigil owner authorizes a proxy to vote with their own, but may later disown decisions they reject. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Vagrancy (ars-magica-houses#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: House vagrancy. condition. A magus without House membership or a qualifying residential Tribunal can face a vagrancy charge and be ordered to correct their status. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Rhine Corruption (ars-magica-houses#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sigil ghost. other. A deceased or missing magus’s unreported sigil is passed through proxies to create an illicit additional vote. [verb copy] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Tribunal Procedures (ars-magica-houses#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Presiding Quaesitor. class-or-role. The Tribunal officer who oversees cases, rules on disputed facts, and may offer a lesser penalty after conviction. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Penalties — Wizard’s March (ars-magica-houses#021); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wizard’s March. condition. An expelled magus loses legal protection and may be killed with impunity, while the Order’s magi hunt the outlaw. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Punishments — Loss of Familiar (ars-magica-houses#021); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Familiar-cord cutting ritual. ritual-or-art. A Quaesitor uses a ritual, paid for with the convicted magus’s vis, to sever the bond between magus and familiar and cause lasting separation. [verb end] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Endorsing Testimony (ars-magica-houses#021); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Oath of Truth. ritual-or-art. A ritual used with senior magi is regarded as infallible for checking testimony, although infernal powers can fool magic generally. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Quaesitor in Good Standing (ars-magica-houses#021); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Quaesitor in good standing. class-or-role. A Quaesitor with a Primus-signed letter less than seven years old may demand investigative cooperation and preside at Tribunal. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Being a Hoplite (ars-magica-houses#021); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hoplite. class-or-role. A magus known for supplying martial magic to investigations may serve as a Quaesitor’s combat ally. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Being a Terrae-Magus (ars-magica-houses#021); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Terrae-Magus. class-or-role. A member of a Guernicus-founded earth-magic cult, often trained in geomantia and sometimes able to summon and bargain with earth elementals. [verb none; also needs familiar-summon] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Being a Terrae-Magus (ars-magica-houses#021); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Geomantia. other. A divinatory ability possessed by many Terrae-Magus cultists and used in investigations. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Acute Sense (ars-magica-houses#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Acute Sense. feat-or-talent. A Quaesitor-trained magus can detect deceptive or missing traces with enhanced magical senses, and its second purchase adds Mastery to the detection roll. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Fenicil's Rituals — Greater Rituals (ars-magica-houses#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Curse of Thoth. ritual-or-art. A group ritual involving sacrifice curses a magical group so penetrated members treat all magical rolls as stressed, double botch dice, and gain a Twilight-prone flaw for a year. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Embryonic Initiation of a Refinement Mystery (ars-magica-houses#031); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Embryonic Initiation of a Refinement Mystery. other. A season-long rite at an ancestor site consumes vis, causes Warping, and initiates a refinement usable only in inner-heartbeast form. [verb add; also needs body-form] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Refinements (ars-magica-houses#031); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Changing Size. other. This refinement increases inner-heartbeast Size one point at a time without the usual Strength or Quickness changes. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Refinements (ars-magica-houses#031); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Increasing Characteristic Scores. other. This refinement increases one inner-heartbeast Characteristic other than Intelligence by 1. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Refinements (ars-magica-houses#031); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Acquiring Qualities. other. This refinement adds an animal Quality to the inner heartbeast. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Refinements (ars-magica-houses#031); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Acquiring Virtues. other. This refinement grants the inner heartbeast an allowed Minor or Major Virtue. [verb add; also needs power-granting] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Refinements (ars-magica-houses#031); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Acquiring Powers. other. This refinement adds a supernatural effect to the inner heartbeast, with Minor Powers limited to self-effects or magical senses and Major Powers able to affect others. [verb add; also needs body-form] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Huntress in the Wood (ars-magica-houses#031); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Huntress in the Wood. class-or-role. This secret cult pursues wilderness mysteries and seeks to train a pagan messiah to find Quendalon and transform Hermetic practice. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Kerykes (ars-magica-houses#031); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Kerykes. class-or-role. The cult’s outer members study nature lore and join through initiation into Nature Lore and an oath of obedience. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Eumolpids (ars-magica-houses#031); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Eumolpids. class-or-role. The cult’s religious members worship Diana and seek the pagan messiah, with initiation granting Hermetic Theurgy. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Hierophants (ars-magica-houses#031); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hierophants. class-or-role. Three elected leaders direct the cult, and upon appointment a leader is initiated into Hermetic Synthemata by the other two. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues: Clan Ilfetu (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Clan Ilfetu. feat-or-talent. Grants 50 experience points for House Bjornaer Lore, Great Beasts Magic Lore, and Gothic, and teaches blood-splatter divination with bonuses of +5 for family and +3 for Corpus. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues: Keen Sense of Smell (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Keen Sense of Smell. feat-or-talent. Provides a +3 bonus to rolls that rely on smell, including tracking with Hunt. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues: Pack leader / natural leader (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Pack leader / natural leader. feat-or-talent. Grants +3 in social situations where the character takes the lead, and may temporarily counter a Gifted character’s social penalty. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Flaws: Feral Scent (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Feral Scent. condition. Imposes −1 on social interactions and an Unclean reputation at level 2, but doubles the area of the character’s Scent-Target spells if Sensory Magic has been initiated. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Abilities: Heartbeast (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Heartbeast. condition. After the Ritual of Twelve Years, this ability provides animal-species understanding, an animal-named personality trait at half the ability score, and the power to change form. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Qualities: Ambush Predator (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ambush Predator. feat-or-talent. After successfully stalking prey, the beast automatically wins initiative and gains +3 to its attack total in the first combat round. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Qualities: Aquatic (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Aquatic. feat-or-talent. Grants Swim 5 and the ability to breathe underwater. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Qualities: Camouflage (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Camouflage. feat-or-talent. Grants +3 to hiding rolls while the creature remains still. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Qualities: Grapple (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Grapple. feat-or-talent. Allows a grapple attack against an opponent no larger than one Size above the creature, and lets a natural weapon attack add current Grapple Strength in later rounds until the victim breaks free. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Qualities: Herd Animal (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Herd Animal. feat-or-talent. When fighting as a group, the animal temporarily gains Ferocity to stampede or escape a threat; alone, it lacks this benefit unless it has Ferocity separately. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Qualities: Mimicry (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Mimicry. feat-or-talent. Lets the creature imitate sounds and raises Communication, but does not make it understand them unless it has Intelligence. [verb copy] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Qualities: Pack Animal (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Pack Animal. feat-or-talent. Allows the creatures to fight as a Trained Group when a Pack Leader is present, or as an Untrained Group without one. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Qualities: Slippery (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Slippery. feat-or-talent. Grants +6 to defense against grapple attacks, with each additional instance adding +3 more. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Qualities: Spiny (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Spiny. feat-or-talent. Adds 1 Protection and causes an attacker using a bite, claw, or fist to suffer 5 damage in return. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Qualities: Venomous (ars-magica-houses#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Venomous. feat-or-talent. One attack delivers venom when its Attack Advantage exceeds the victim’s Protection, whether or not the attack causes a wound. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Practices & Beliefs; Riddles (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Enigmatic Wisdom. other. A trained way of interpreting riddles and experience that helps a magus pursue the House’s ultimate puzzle. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Stigmata (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Stigmata. other. Unchosen skin patterns that reflect a Criamon magus’s development and history, change with transformative learning, and cannot be magically removed. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Body Modification Rules — Other Modifications (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Head binding. other. Childhood binding alters skull shape to grant a matching path a +3 bonus to the first station’s Initiation Script. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Riddles (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Riddle of the Magus. other. A teacher’s question formally prompts an apprentice ready to become a magus to indicate a path, with the apprentice’s later life serving as the deeper answer. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Repose: House Criamon's Alternative to Death (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Repose. other. The endpoint of a path is a blissful state in place of ordinary death, which a magus may defer to continue helping others. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Final Transmission (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Perfect transmission. other. A magus fading into a path’s repose can encode wisdom in a place or object for others to learn through contemplation. [verb copy; also needs place-release] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Perfect Transmission Site Example (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Niobe’s spring. other. A magical pool lets a qualified visitor study one Art per season as if studying a pawn of vis, for Arts below score 5; concurrent students must choose the same Art, and the aura is 1. [verb add; also needs area-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Realm of Magic (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Inspirato. other. The House’s name for magical energy imagined as an ocean that pools into auras and sometimes concentrates into vis. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Glossary; Cosmology for Criamon Magi (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Alam. other. A mystical state far removed from ordinary human life whose alignment with the four realms is uncertain. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Glossary; The Hypostasis (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hypostasis. other. The place Criamon magi believe lies outside time and offers final rest beyond the universe. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Counter-Cyclical Alam (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Counter-cyclical alam. other. A conjectured environment associated with a reversed phase of the time cycle, with competing accounts of its nature and inhabitants. [verb none; also needs time-manipulation] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Circle of Time; Glossary (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Spharios. other. The cosmological state of perfect harmony imagined as a sphere of undifferentiated matter. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Circle of Time; Glossary (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Harmony. other. A cosmic force said to draw things together and promote cohesion. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Circle of Time; Glossary (ars-magica-houses#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Strife. other. A cosmic force said to divide things and promote change and separation. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Cave of Twisting Shadows; The Secret of the Axis Magica, and What Lies Beyond (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Axis Magica. other. A living bridge formed from Criamon connects the world to the refuge outside time and is believed movable within a Primus’s body. [verb move; also needs area-field, world-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Spectral Primi; The Paths (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Path of the Mirror. other. The living Prima follows this service-oriented path under instruction from spectral predecessors and can hear ghosts, sense or distort magical currents, and bind spirits to places or objects within the regio. [verb bind; also needs spirit-contract-judgement, area-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Labyrinth Meditations (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Labyrinth Meditations. ritual-or-art. Walking a maze while contemplating a problem focuses the magus for one hour and improves one eligible roll. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Path of the Body (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Path of the Body. other. A spiritual path that studies and alters the body through five stations, each granting powers maintained by appropriate conduct. [verb transform; also needs power-granting] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of Subduing the Meat and the Station of the Perfect Tool (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Perfect Tool. feat-or-talent. This station grants Minor Potency in a Corpus aspect, lets Enigmatic Wisdom substitute for Medicine or Chirurgy, and instinctively detects illness and its location. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of Drinking the Winds of Inspiration and the Station of Spiritual Nourishment (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Spiritual Nourishment. feat-or-talent. In suitable realms, the magus sustains the body through six hours of daily meditation instead of needing food, drink, breath, or sleep, while ceasing to age and gaining yearly Warping. [verb alter; also needs body-code-decay] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of the Tiniest Seed and the Station of Perfect Economy of Movement (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of the Spherical Mirror and the Station of the Microcosm (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of Repose in the Body and the Threshold of Corporeal Repose (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Threshold of Corporeal Repose. other. This station is described as purifying the magus of mortal frailties. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Famous Primi (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Travels of Fedoso. other. An epic poem used to teach Latin is believed by some Criamon magi to predict the House’s future calamities. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Story Seeds for The Travels of Fedoso (ars-magica-houses#034); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Premonitions Virtue. other. Verderis’s foresight lets him predict a calamity and identify characters suited to address it. [verb sense; also needs future-vision] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Avenue of Gruel, Water and Starlight (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station of Differentiation of Seeming. feat-or-talent. The initiate gains Clear Thinker, Common Sense, and Keen Vision, with Keen Vision exchangeable for a comparable benefit to another sense. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Avenue That Assaults the Modesty of the Universe (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Avenue of the Unexpected Pages (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station of Vivid Memories from Objects. feat-or-talent. Touching a mundane object lets the magus recall its history as if experienced through that object’s senses, but not memories of self-aware beings. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue That Is a Crossroad (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station of Passing Through Seeming. feat-or-talent. The magus sends a ghostlike spirit through magical space to a destination, where it can see and speak but usually cannot handle mundane objects. [verb move; also needs dimension-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue That Leads to Transcendence (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station from Which to Ignore the Real. feat-or-talent. The magus briefly treats mundane objects as spectral, with the number of objects increasing the difficulty and people remaining immune. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of Faith in Strife (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue That Splinters (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station of Blood and Bronze. feat-or-talent. The initiate destroys mundane matter through meditation and exploits flaws to make exceptionally powerful weapon strikes. [verb end; also needs object-surface, power-interaction] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Avenue of Charm and Scorn (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station That Repels and Attracts Elements. feat-or-talent. The initiate moves aware mundane objects toward or away from himself, subject to a combined weight limit and ward protection. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of Befriending the Silent (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station That Charms the Elements. feat-or-talent. The initiate speaks with spirits in pure, non-organic elemental objects and can persuade them to provide information or make minor movements. [verb bind; also needs creature-control] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Avenue of Death (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station of Golden Cider. feat-or-talent. After preparation and sustained bare-hand contact, the initiate strips strife from eligible supernatural targets, often making them mundane or symbolic. [verb transform; also needs form-transformation] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of Surrender (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station of Service to Harmony. feat-or-talent. Purification changes the Gift to Gentle or removes Blatant Gift, while later Warping cannot restore those traits and instead produces another effect. [verb alter; also needs mind-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of Healing (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station of Rice and Honey. feat-or-talent. The initiate meditates to restore eligible non-human things and can hold a dying human at death’s threshold while others help. [verb law: repair; also needs death-checkpoint-rewind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of Adulation (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station of Expression. feat-or-talent. The initiate gains Free Expression and Inspirational, may substitute Enigmatic Wisdom for one artistic skill, and communicates persuasive ideas through art. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Avenue of a Thousand Beautiful Faces (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Station of Exaltation. feat-or-talent. Meditation brings out one plausible positive quality already latent in a mundane object, but cannot add magical properties or alter human virtues. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Path of Walking Backwards, Illustrated Arithmetically (ars-magica-houses#035); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Immortal Ascension. feat-or-talent. The initiate may choose an apparent age and gender at the path’s final station. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues — Dance That Heals (ars-magica-houses#036); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Dance That Heals. feat-or-talent. The character can dance objects back into wholeness. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues — Guest of the House (ars-magica-houses#036); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Guest of the House. feat-or-talent. The character belongs politically to House Criamon but may use another House’s character-creation rules. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues — Gorgiastic (ars-magica-houses#036); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Gorgiastic. feat-or-talent. The character may have Enigmatic Wisdom and House Criamon Lore after creation, but Enigmatic Wisdom cannot exceed 4 without Criamon assistance or a magical breakthrough. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues — Speech with the Silent (ars-magica-houses#036); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Speech with the Silent. feat-or-talent. The character can charm elemental objects into helping. [verb bind; also needs creature-control] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Flaws — Malignant Magus (ars-magica-houses#036); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Malignant Magus. condition. A detached part of the character’s psyche manifests as an adulteration that secretly attacks the character’s enemies with a magical monster, without conscious consent. [verb law: summon; also needs mind-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Flaws — Predictive Stigmata (ars-magica-houses#036); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Predictive Stigmata. condition. The character’s moving stigmata symbolically foretell challenges and may escape the body and become adulterations if ignored. [verb sense; also needs projection-body] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Sample Wayfarers Initiation: Arcadian Travel (ars-magica-houses#036); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Arcadian Travel. power. This Mystery allows an initiate to create temporary gateways to Arcadia, which may be unguarded but are not necessarily safe. [verb move; also needs portal-space] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: History (ars-magica-houses#036); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Enchantment that Binds a Familiar. ritual-or-art. This enchantment joins a magus’s mind, body, and spirit with an animal familiar through magical cords, sharing their thoughts and feelings. [verb bind; also needs mind-binding, bond-slots] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Famous Figures — Alsia (ars-magica-houses#036); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Temporary Familiar Ritual. ritual-or-art. Alsia invented a ritual for temporary familiars. [verb law: summon] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Enchanting (Ability). feat-or-talent. In Faerie auras, the character can use a chosen art form to change or control events according to how well the art depicts them. [verb alter; also needs area-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie-Raised Magic. feat-or-talent. The magus can learn eligible non-ritual spells outside the laboratory by spending experience, and gains Spell Improvisation. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Virtues (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Independent Study. feat-or-talent. The character gains +2 Source Quality from Practice and +3 Source Quality from Adventure experience. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Flaws (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Offensive to (Beings). condition. One chosen class of humans, demons, or divine beings reacts to the character as if she had the Gift, imposing –3 on social interaction rolls with them. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Abilities (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: House Merinita Lore. feat-or-talent. This ability represents knowledge of the House's rites, mysteries, and legends and is used to initiate members into its mysteries. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Enchanting a Faerie Familiar (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
