source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Enchanting a Faerie Familiar (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Shared Senses. condition. The bonded pair can each detect when the other perceives an irregularity through faerie senses and gain a general sense of its direction and distance. [verb sense; also needs bond-slots] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Enchanting a Faerie Familiar (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Shared Fatigue. condition. A faerie familiar recovers Might by resting and can spend Might Points to absorb Fatigue loss that would otherwise affect the maga. [verb law: transfer; also needs bond-slots] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Faerie Chains of the Familiar Slave (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie Chains of the Familiar Slave. ritual-or-art. This ritual binds a supernatural creature to the caster as a familiar until a condition occurs, starting the bond's cords at 0. [verb bind; also needs familiar-summon, spirit-contract-judgement] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Three Faerie Cords (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Leaden Cord. condition. This negative familiar cord increases botch dice in the Dominion or near holy objects and reduces resistance to Divine influence by its value. [verb alter; also needs negative-effect-drift] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Three Faerie Cords (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Iron Cord. condition. This negative familiar cord penalizes the maga's rolls while she touches iron, reduces her Soak against iron weapons, and adds botch dice in an Infernal aura. [verb alter; also needs negative-effect-drift] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Three Faerie Cords (ars-magica-houses#037); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Tin Cord. condition. This negative familiar cord is identified as one of the three cords, but its specific effect is not given in the passage. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Binding the Gift (Minor House Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Binding the Gift. feat-or-talent. Makes a familiar inherit the magus’s Gift-related social discomforts and protections, with cord effects modifying social rolls. [verb alter; also needs bond-slots] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Binding the Gift (Minor House Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Golden Gift. other. Adds the golden cord’s value to social rolls with magical beings, including those with magical background. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Binding the Gift (Minor House Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Silver Gift. other. Adds the silver cord’s value to social rolls with faeries and beings of faerie background. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Binding the Gift (Minor House Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Bronze Gift. other. Adds the bronze cord’s value to social rolls involving mundane animals when the Gift would otherwise trouble them. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Binding the Gift (Minor House Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Leaden Cord. other. Subtracts its value from social rolls around Divine beings, in the Dominion, or while touching Divine-associated things. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Binding the Gift (Minor House Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Iron Cord. other. Subtracts its value from social rolls in Infernal auras, with Infernal beings or tainted objects, and while touching iron. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Binding the Gift (Minor House Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Tin Cord (Gift effect). other. Subtracts its value from social rolls involving ordinary people without supernatural background. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Arcadian Travel (Minor Arcadian Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Arcadian Travel. feat-or-talent. Opens a charm-linked trod to travel between regio levels, Arcadia, and the mortal world, carrying participating companions within its limit. [verb move; also needs portal-space] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Arcadian Travel (Minor Arcadian Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Trods. other. Paths that connect Faerie levels with one another and with the mundane world, sometimes reaching Arcadia. [verb move; also needs world-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Animae Magic (Major Arcadian Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Animae Magic. feat-or-talent. Summons faeries associated with a Form or transforms mundane things into temporary living faeries. [verb transform; also needs plant-or-creature-target] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Becoming (Major Arcadian Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Becoming. feat-or-talent. Uses three seasonal rituals to transform a maga’s body, mind, and spirit into faerie nature, irreversibly. [verb transform; also needs body-form, mind-state, soul-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Becoming — Transforming the Body (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Transforming the Body. ritual-or-art. Stops aging and fatigue, removes Fatigue Levels, and fixes the character’s apparent age, while ordinary exertion is unavailable. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Becoming — Transforming the Mind (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Transforming the Mind. ritual-or-art. Removes the need for sleep and grants two extra non-lab seasons yearly, but prevents new Ability learning and non-similar spell invention. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Becoming — Transforming the Spirit (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Transforming the Spirit. ritual-or-art. Sacrifices the Gift, grants Faerie Might and Warping immunity, and makes magical work cost Might Points. [verb alter; also needs power-transfer] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Becoming — lesser transformation rituals (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Altering the Enchantment. ritual-or-art. Changes the existing Becoming ritual’s appearance, personality Arts, or associated Might Form at the original ritual’s level. [verb alter; also needs mind-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Becoming — lesser transformation rituals (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Inspired Knowledge. ritual-or-art. Grants score 1 in a new learnable Ability for 5 experience points, or masters a known spell, at a level based on Ability scores. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Becoming — lesser transformation rituals (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Empowered Faerie. ritual-or-art. Adds a spell-like faerie power or reduces its Might cost, with every five levels of excess reducing its activation cost by one Might Point. [verb add; also needs power-transfer] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Line of Quendalon (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Line of Quendalon. class-or-role. A lineage of Merinitae associated with Arcadian Mysteries, faerie research, and loyalty to the House’s Primus. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Charm Magic (Minor Folk Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Charm Magic. feat-or-talent. Builds specific symbolic charms into spells to improve casting and, with an Arcane Connection, penetration. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Story Magic (Major Folk Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Story Magic. other. Spends a Confidence Point to make a prepared story charm influence events during the session, or substitute for a same-category spell charm. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Symbolic Magic (Major Folk Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Symbolic Magic. feat-or-talent. Uses charms in device design, talisman attunement, transferable charms, and ritual effects with symbol-based range, duration, or target. [verb add; also needs power-interaction, divination-fate] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Symbol Range, Duration, & Target (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Symbol Range. ritual-or-art. A ritual affects the unique target identified by a symbol as though the caster had an Arcane Connection. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Symbol Range, Duration, & Target (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Symbol Duration. ritual-or-art. A ritual lasts while its physical symbol remains intact and its identifying qualities still apply, ending or pausing if those conditions fail. [verb end] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Symbol Range, Duration, & Target (ars-magica-houses#038); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Symbol Target. ritual-or-art. A ritual affects all targets represented by a symbol within range, using a boundary-scale target. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Illusion Mysteries — Spell Timing (ars-magica-houses#039); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Spell Timing. power. Grants access to delayed, scheduled, and condition-based spell durations with the stated limits and costs. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Illusion Mysteries — Glamour (ars-magica-houses#039); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Glamour. power. Creates or transforms Imaginem effects into materially effective illusions that can affect their surroundings. [verb transform; also needs object-surface] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Illusion Mysteries — Perpetuity (ars-magica-houses#039); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Perpetuity. power. Provides three ritual-only, Year-level durations that last while a Might-bearing subject lives, while a target remains in an aura, or while a target stays hidden. [verb end; also needs containment-rule] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Nature Mysteries — Nature Lore (ars-magica-houses#039); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Nature Lore. feat-or-talent. Provides domain-specific local knowledge and, at higher scores, supernatural detection, communication, aid, targeting, and command over associated nature. [verb sense; also needs divination-fate, creature-control, plant-or-creature-target] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Nature Mysteries — Awakening (ars-magica-houses#039); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Awakening. ritual-or-art. Uses a season-long ritual and vis to give a representative natural subject intelligence and, if desired, invest it with Might-powered effects. [verb transform; also needs power-granting] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Nature Mysteries — Wilding (ars-magica-houses#039); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wilding. power. Produces temporary, immediately usable vis from a wholly natural vessel, yielding twice the Nature Lore score in pawns of an appropriate Form. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Nature Mysteries — Guardian of Nature (ars-magica-houses#039); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Guardian of Nature. ritual-or-art. Joins the maga to a magical natural area as its intangible guardian, able to perceive and control its nature but vulnerable to damage to the locus. [verb transform; also needs area-field, body-form, soul-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Outer Mystery of Verditius Magic (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Verditius Magic. feat-or-talent. A minor Hermetic virtue gained through a forge initiation, associated with using tools to cast formulaic spells. [verb law: power-granting] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Early Years of House Verditius (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Verditius Runes. other. Philosophically grounded runes whose benefit in an enchanted item depends on how well the enchanter understands their symbolic connection to the object. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Journeymen and Masters (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Forge-companions. other. UnGifted assistants with the same craft ability the magus uses can contribute +1 to the magus’s Lab Total per 5 levels of their Craft Ability; the magus’s Leadership score limits their number. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Journeymen and Masters (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Venditores. other. Each magus has one trusted selling agent, who negotiates sales of one enchanted item per year to mundane buyers. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Outer Mystery of Verditius Magic (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Outer Mystery initiation. other. During the season the apprentice’s Arts are opened, a forge initiation grants Verditius Magic; it has target level 15, requires the Mystagogue’s Presence plus Cult Lore to total 3, and receives a +12 script bonus. [verb law: power-granting] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Verditius Initiation Scripts (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Verditius Inner Mystery initiation scripts. ritual-or-art. Script bonuses include +3 for a specified place and time, +3 for a specific quest, +6 for a unique quest, +3 or +9 for an ordeal causing a Minor or Major Flaw, +1 for the Initiate’s service, +3 or +6 for sacrificing a lesser or greater item, +3 for Mystagogue training, +1 for wealth, and +6 when the Outer Mystery coincides with opening the Arts. [verb law: power-granting] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Prices for Enchantments (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Verditius enchantment prices. other. The standard price is twice the vis needed to make an item in addition to project costs; mundane buyers are charged 15 Mythic Pounds per vis cost, subject to House rules and local variation. [verb law: fixed pricing] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Crises in the Order (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Mundane item-sale limit. other. A Verditius magus may sell one magical item per year to mundane buyers through intermediaries, though a tribunal may alter the limit; sales to Hermetic magi are unlimited. [verb law: sale limit] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Contest (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Contest. other. Every 18 years Verditius magi compete with enchanted items in apprentice, journeyman, and master categories; the entries become Verdi’s property, and winners choose respectively one, two, or three stored items as prizes. [verb law: competition rules] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Apprenticeship (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Verditius apprenticeship. other. Apprentices receive 15 years of Hermetic instruction and craft training, then an additional season to make a lesser enchanted masterpiece that serves as their Gauntlet. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: New Ability: Verditius Cult Lore (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Verditius Cult Lore. other. An Arcane Ability covering the House’s history, secrets, rituals, formulas, membership, initiation practices, and appropriate social conduct. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Journeymen and Masters (ars-magica-houses#040); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Verditius forge-companion limit. other. A magus may have as many forge-companions as their Leadership score; apprentices do not count toward that limit. [verb law: capacity limit] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ordeals (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sever the Ties That Bind. feat-or-talent. This Ordeal removes existing family and friendship attachments and can bar their replacement, with its severity determining the Flaw received. [verb remove; also needs bond-slots] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ordeals (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Self-Mutilation. feat-or-talent. This Ordeal inflicts lasting bodily damage that physical and magical healing cannot undo. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ordeals (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Prone to Chance. feat-or-talent. The magus becomes compelled to experiment during every laboratory activity that permits experimentation. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ordeals (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Averse to Risk. feat-or-talent. The magus avoids risky laboratory work and may never experiment on laboratory activities. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Ordeals (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Increased Hubris. feat-or-talent. This Ordeal grants enough Hubris experience to raise the score by one level. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Roland (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Confraternity of Roland. class-or-role. This small sword-making group initiates members into a sword-focused magical specialty and teaches its associated crafting path. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Roland — Initiation Mystery (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Minor Magical Focus (Swords). feat-or-talent. This initiation grants a magical focus related to swords. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Balento (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Confraternity of Balento. class-or-role. This group crafts fire-imbued devices and initiates members into affinity with Ignem while imposing a deficiency in Aquam. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Balento — Initiation Mystery (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Affinity with Ignem. feat-or-talent. Initiation into the group grants an affinity for Ignem and also imposes Deficient Form Aquam. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Balento — Initiation Mystery (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Deficient Form Aquam. power. This flaw limits the Initiate’s ability in the Aquam Form. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Irene the Younger (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Confraternity of Irene the Younger. class-or-role. This group makes paintings, statues, and mosaics whose powers can subtly affect viewers and their surroundings. [verb alter; also needs area-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Irene the Younger — Initiation Mystery (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Puissant Imaginem. feat-or-talent. This initiation grants a Minor Virtue focused on Imaginem and also imposes Slow Caster. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Irene the Younger — Initiation Mystery (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Puissant Mentem. feat-or-talent. This initiation grants a Minor Virtue focused on Mentem and also imposes Slow Caster. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Himinis the Mad (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Confraternity of Himinis the Mad. class-or-role. This group makes magical devices and specializes in trick items and curses bound into items. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Himinis the Mad — Initiation Mystery (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Minor Magical Focus (Wooden Wands). feat-or-talent. This initiation grants a magical focus related to wooden wands and imposes Envious. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Confraternity of Himinis the Mad — Initiation Mystery (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Envious. condition. The initiate receives a Minor Personality Flaw of envy. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Enchant Casting Tools (Minor House Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Enchant Casting Tools. ritual-or-art. A season-long laboratory process binds spell-related effects and casting bonuses into a casting tool, subject to Lab Total and vis limits. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Reforging Enchanted Items (Minor House Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Reforging Enchanted Items. ritual-or-art. This Mystery allows a magus to repair broken enchanted items, increase device capacity by reforging, or recover vis by smelting devices. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Repairing Enchanted Items (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Repairing Enchanted Items. ritual-or-art. The magus physically repairs a broken device, investigates each power, and restores its enchantments one at a time. [verb law: repair] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Reforging Enchanted Devices (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Reforging Enchanted Devices. ritual-or-art. The magus compresses an item’s magic to add capacity, with each successful reforging making its powers harder to reforge again. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Smelting Enchanted Devices (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Smelting Enchanted Devices. ritual-or-art. After investigating a device, the magus removes its powers and extracts some of the vis used to instill them, with at least one pawn lost. [verb remove; also needs ingredient-properties] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Verditius Elder Runes (Minor House Mystery) (ars-magica-houses#041); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Verditius Elder Runes. ritual-or-art. These Art-linked runes inscribed during item creation double the enchanter’s score in the associated Art for that item. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Automata — Enchanting an Automaton (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Dutiful Movement. power. Makes an automaton walk and follow its creator, with a base effect of 20. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Automata — Enchanting an Automaton (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Freedom of Movement. power. Lets an automaton walk toward a destination specifically selected by its maker when commanding it; base effect 25 with a Mentem requisite. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Automata — Enchanting an Automaton (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Angelic Movement. power. Allows a suitably shaped automaton to fly in the direction indicated by its maker; base effect 40, with an additional magnitude for each Size above 0. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Automata — Enchanting an Automaton (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Voice Like a Nightingale. power. Makes an automaton produce pleasant birdlike singing, at base effect 5. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Automata — Enchanting an Automaton (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Voice Like a Bard. power. Lets an automaton sing a small repertoire of ballads selected when it is enchanted, at base effect 10. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Automata — Enchanting an Automaton (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Increased Characteristics. power. Raises an automaton’s Characteristic by +1 per magnitude above a base effect of 10. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Automata — Enchanting an Automaton (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Simulacra. power. Makes an automaton look, smell, and sound real; one additional magnitude can make it resemble a particular person or animal. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Automata — Enchanting an Automaton (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Cease. power. A command trigger that stops the specific activity or power the automaton is currently performing, adding 3 levels to the effect. [verb end] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Automata in Play (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Automaton Deterioration. condition. Annual wear reduces Might on a failed check, penalizes Ability rolls as Might falls, and leaves the automaton unusable at Might 0. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Bind Curse — Minor Curses (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Weakened Characteristic. power. Reduces the victim’s lowest physical Characteristic by 1 point. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Bind Curse — Minor Curses (ars-magica-houses#042); licence Ars Magica Open License

Adds 3 to the season’s Lab Total while limiting the worker to five rest days; every two seasons also cause one Warping Point and three botch dice, and stopping requires a recovery roll against three times the consecutive-season count. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Laboratory Specializations (ars-magica-houses#055); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Laboratory Virtues and Flaws — Minor Structure Virtues (ars-magica-houses#055); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Laboratory Virtues and Flaws — Minor Structure Virtues (ars-magica-houses#055); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Laboratory Items: The Bookstand of Hespera (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Laboratory Items: The Crown of Hermes (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Crown of Hermes. power. The wearer can meditate to create and improve an imaginary lab, remember its state between uses, and suffers one Warping point on first use and one per year of use. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Laboratory Items: The Prodigious Plant Pot (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Prodigious Plant Pot. power. A seed or seedling planted in loam grows into a mature plant in a day, and the pot improves Experimentation and Herbam Specializations by one and two points. [verb transform; also needs item-bound-power] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Example Laboratory Items: The Tireless Servant (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Outfittings Virtues: Highly Organized (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Highly Organized. condition. A well-arranged lab gains one General Quality, but loses the benefit after a major accident, another person’s use, or help from someone with lower Intelligence. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Outfittings Virtues: Spotless (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Spotless. condition. A season of work can make a lab spotless, adding one Health and Aesthetics, but neglect or an accident removes the benefit. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Outfittings Flaws: Missing Ingredients (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Missing Ingredients. condition. Lacking ingredients for one Technique or two Forms halves the corresponding Lab Totals until the deficiency is remedied. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Minor Outfittings Flaws: Missing Equipment (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Missing Equipment. condition. Missing equipment makes one activity category, or two other categories, impossible; it cannot be taken more than twice. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Major Outfittings Flaws: Elementary (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Elementary. condition. A reduced lab permits only one fixed category of lab activity, costs less Upkeep, and can be completed in one season. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Major Structure Flaws: Greater Focus (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Greater Focus. condition. A lab’s Greater Feature dominates its work, improving its related Specializations by four points while reducing General Quality by two and hindering unrelated activities. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Minor Structure Flaws: Lesser Focus (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Lesser Focus. condition. A lab’s Lesser Feature dominates its work, improving related Specializations by two points while reducing General Quality by one and hindering unrelated activities. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Minor Structure Flaws: Cramped (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Cramped. condition. Crowded equipment hampers all but one activity, which gains a Specialization point; a season of work can change the favored activity. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Minor Structure Flaws: No Stores (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: No Stores. condition. A lab without supply storage cannot withstand shortages, must take Upkeep-reducing flaws immediately when funds fail, and stores vis and dangerous materials unsafely. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Minor Supernatural Flaws: Living (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Major Supernatural Flaws: Mental Construct (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Mental Construct. condition. An imagined lab has Size no greater than its magus’s Intelligence and, without sophisticated magic, cannot support several activities including familiar bonding, item enchantment, Longevity Rituals, and teaching. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Supernatural Virtues: Boundless (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Boundless. condition. The inside of the lab has as much space as desired despite its exterior, and the effect adds two Warping. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Supernatural Virtues: Regio (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Supernatural Virtues: Relocation (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Relocation. condition. Magic can adjust the lab’s physical location, making travel easier but the lab harder to find; constant relocation adds one Warping. [verb move; also needs conceal-or-sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Minor Supernatural Virtues: Gateway (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Gateway. condition. The lab lies at a supernatural passage whose access the owner usually controls and which may allow passage or yield tolls. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Supernatural Virtues: Airborne (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Airborne. condition. The lab flies on winds or clouds and rarely lands, with high upkeep, reduced Safety, and increased Warping among its effects. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Supernatural Virtues: Invisible (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License

note: Magical Heating. condition. Magic provides either ordinary or excessive heating without the usual space or Upkeep cost. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Supernatural Virtues: Magical Lighting (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Supernatural Flaws: Thoroughfare (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License

note: Gremlins. condition. Disruptive creatures, spirits, or demons inhabit the lab and interfere with it, lowering Safety and Aesthetics while increasing Warping. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Free Supernatural Flaws: Haunted (ars-magica-houses#056); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Haunted. condition. A haunting spirit occasionally disturbs the lab’s owner and increases Warping. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

note: Lair. condition. A creature hides or hibernates in the lab, lowering Safety and increasing Warping. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

note: Cauldron. other. A large vessel heats and mixes substantial quantities of ingredients. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

note: Mirror. other. A reflective surface supports Intellego, Imaginem, and Mentem work. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Mongol Trooper (ars-magica-magic#001); licence Ars Magica Open License

note: Turn the Unworthy. power. A guardian immediately sends a forbidden target to the next lower regio level, bypassing resistance from Might or other Magic Resistance. [verb move; also needs containment-rule] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Seeking Lost Babylon (ars-magica-magic#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Infernal regio beneath Babylon. other. A level 3 Infernal regio conceals a deep pit containing the suspended fallen angels Harut and Marut. [verb conceal; also needs conceal-or-sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: The Garden of Eden (ars-magica-magic#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Divine regio of Eden. other. A three-level regio beneath the Persian Gulf opens into a guarded paradise whose described upper levels lie at 5 and 10. [verb move; also needs dimension-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: The Animals (ars-magica-magic#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Eden’s animal speech blessing. condition. Animals in the garden can communicate in Adamic, but gain neither Intelligence nor supernatural powers. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: The Animals (ars-magica-magic#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Eden’s needs and seasons. condition. Within Eden, inhabitants do not hunger or thirst, need no sleep, or experience changing seasons. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: The Animals (ars-magica-magic#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Loss of The Gift in Eden. condition. Magi in animal form cannot cast spells or use devices requiring activation, although existing and continual effects persist. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Adamic Writing (ars-magica-magic#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Adamic Writing. feat-or-talent. A fluent Adamic writer with Artes Liberales 1 can inscribe a name-symbol on a target to create an Arcane Connection and a possible association with Cain. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Cain, the Fugitive — Powers (ars-magica-magic#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Desperate Speed. power. For 3 points, Cain travels twice a normal man’s distance and gains +7 Initiative. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Cain, the Fugitive — Powers (ars-magica-magic#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Supernatural Fury. power. For 3 points, Cain ignores wound penalties and gains +4 Attack while in a murderous rage. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Cain, the Fugitive — Powers (ars-magica-magic#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Rush of Strength. power. For 3 points, Cain’s next blow deals an additional 4 damage. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Cain, the Fugitive — Powers (ars-magica-magic#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Shadow of Cain. power. Cain separates a shadow of himself at a cost of 10 Might and one +3 Personality Trait, producing an independent being that can later recombine with the others. [verb transform; also needs power-transfer] (batched reader, unchecked)

note: Cain’s Curse. condition. Cain is transformed into a fugitive monster, and anyone who kills him inherits a curse that deforms and banishes them and makes them a shadow after death. [verb transform; also needs revival-on-death, soul-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Major Supernatural Virtue: Canaanite Necromancy (ars-magica-magic#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Canaanite Necromancy. condition. This supernatural tradition lets its user attempt Corpus or Mentem effects for communicating with, commanding, or summoning the dead using a Communication-based roll. [verb law: power-interaction] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Minor Hermetic Virtue: Canaanite Magic (ars-magica-magic#002); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Canaanite Magic. feat-or-talent. The magus gains Veil of Death range, a permanent connection to the dead, and +4 Penetration against them, but the dead can detect and target the magus in return. [verb alter; also needs conceal-or-sense, power-interaction] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Zephaniah — Powers (ars-magica-magic#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Dead Canaanite Necromancer. power. Zephaniah knows she is a ghost and can become invisible, pass through walls, ignore physical attacks while incorporeal, and use a permanent connection to the dead for +4 Penetration against them. [verb alter; also needs conceal-or-sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Zephaniah — Powers (ars-magica-magic#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Return to Flesh. power. For 10 points, Zephaniah manifests physically for one day, but wounds or fatigue may force her back to ghosthood, and incapacitation, death, or unconsciousness ends the state immediately. [verb transform; also needs soul-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Ghosts of Necromancers — Powers (ars-magica-magic#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Traumatic Death. power. The ghosts are connected to one another, continually share what they sense, and can communicate across any distance. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

note: Marionette. power. For 5 points, a ghost weakly pushes one person’s limbs for a Diameter; a conscious target automatically resists, but multitasking requires a Concentration roll against Ease Factor 9 minus Size. [verb move; also needs mind-binding] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: The Leadworker Virtue (ars-magica-magic#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Leadworker Virtue. feat-or-talent. A Tremere-associated Virtue derived from defixio practice; possessing it neither helps nor hinders integration, though it may provide research sources. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Defixio Lore (ars-magica-magic#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Defixio Lore. ritual-or-art. A supernatural ability for preparing devices that channel a selected spell or ability at a target identified by description, with cult knowledge restricting which Technique and Form combinations can be used. [verb law: power-transfer; also needs power-transfer, conceal-or-sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Magic books and Mysteries: Arcane Ability Fertility Lore (ars-magica-magic#004); licence Ars Magica Open License

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Aillwee Cave (ars-magica-realms#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Grant No Sense of Direction. power. Imposes the No Sense of Direction Flaw through a ritual power. [verb add; also needs mind-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Aillwee Cave (ars-magica-realms#013); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Grant Puissance in Stealth. power. Grants enhanced ability in Stealth. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Kelpie — Character Guide (ars-magica-realms#015); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Equine metamorphosis. power. The kelpie spends 3 points to become a stallion for a Sun, can return at will without further cost, and reverts if soaked unless it succeeds at a Stamina check of 9. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Kelpie — Character Guide (ars-magica-realms#015); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Equine charisma. power. For 2 points, a stallion-form kelpie enthralls creatures with Cunning automatically, while an intelligent target can resist with an Intelligence check of 9. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Kelpie — Character Guide (ars-magica-realms#015); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Fleet of Foot. power. In stallion form, the kelpie moves about three times as fast as an ordinary horse, carrying a rider roughly 100 miles per day. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: New Elementals Spells — Rarefy the Crude Water (ars-magica-realms#015); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Rarefy the Crude Water. ritual-or-art. This Creo Aquam 30 ritual creates a water elemental from a pool up to 5 paces wide and 2 deep, yielding Might 15 and Size 0 at maximum; each extra Size magnitude adds 3 Size and 5 Might. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Air Elementals: Sample Powers (ars-magica-realms#016); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Suffocate. power. The elemental surrounds an opponent and enters its lungs, forcing a deprivation check; escape is a contest of Quickness and Athletics, with the elemental using Might divided by 5 for Athletics, and escape also requires a Fatigue roll. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Character Guide: A Fire Elemental (ars-magica-realms#016); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Enliven the Gross Fire. ritual-or-art. The fire elemental's listed ritual power can spawn additional fire elementals, particularly when it is fought with water. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Pretenses (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Pretenses. power. Faerie glamour lets a faerie imitate human Abilities without Might expenditure or Concentration. [verb copy] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: opening passage (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Broken Faerie Taboo. condition. A human may take a broken faerie taboo as the cause of a Story Flaw, and the taboo may concern hospitality, iron, names, ownership, payment, religion, or bodily openings. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Finding a Regio Entrance (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie Sight. feat-or-talent. This supernatural sense can reveal how to enter the next level of a faerie regio. [verb sense; also needs place-release] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Open Body is Vulnerable to Glamour (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Arcane Connection from Speech. condition. Speaking with a faerie creates a multiplier-2 Arcane Connection that lasts until the conversation ends. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Open Body is Vulnerable to Glamour (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie-Food Guest. condition. Eating a faerie host's food makes the human its servant and prevents departure without permission. [verb bind; also needs mind-binding] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Open Body is Vulnerable to Glamour (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Arcane Connection from Faerie Food. condition. Eating a faerie's food creates a multiplier-2 connection to its glamour until the guest is allowed to leave. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Open Body is Vulnerable to Glamour (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Arcane Connection from Faerie Blood. condition. A faerie that takes or tastes a character's blood gains a multiplier-3 connection until the wound heals. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Open Body is Vulnerable to Glamour (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Arcane Connection from Intercourse. condition. Intercourse with a faerie creates a multiplier-4 connection during the act. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Open Body is Vulnerable to Glamour (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Pregnancy Arcane Connection. condition. Pregnancy creates a multiplier-5 connection between the parents until the pregnancy ends. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Encased Vis (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Encased Vis. condition. This is Magic vis claimed by a faerie's glamour, which the faerie may consume or use to give independent vitality to glamour-made objects. [verb alter; also needs ingredient-properties] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Anchors (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie Trapped in Its Anchor. condition. An anchored faerie remains conscious and in role but cannot use powers except to draw matter into a replacement body. [verb block; also needs body-form] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Faerie Presence (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie Aura. condition. A territory claimed by an Extend Glamour faerie has aura strength based on the claimant's Might, while a contest between two claimants uses a separate capped formula. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Traveling Auras (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Traveling Faerie Glamour. condition. A traveling faerie's glamour temporarily reshapes the surrounding land to match its motif, while physical consequences of human actions remain. [verb transform; also needs form-transformation] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Faerie Roads (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie Road. condition. This traditional route grants faeries right of way, may carry travelers into a regio, and can produce unpredictable travel times. [verb move; also needs time-manipulation, portal-space] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Regiones (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie Regio. condition. A layered faerie place is commonly entered by carrying out a symbolic action, and its levels may present successive tests. [verb law: place-release; also needs dimension-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Ephemeral Exile (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ephemeral Exile. condition. A faerie displaced by another Realm may create a glamour-made duplicate of its part of the mortal world that touches reality at comparatively weak points. [verb transform; also needs area-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Open Body is Vulnerable to Glamour (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie-Child Pregnancy. condition. A human carrying a faerie's child may develop supernatural powers, while the faerie father can often locate her and may try to take the child. [verb alter; also needs divination-fate] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Faerie Presence (ars-magica-realms#018); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Extend Glamour. power. A faerie uses this power to claim an area and produce a faerie aura there. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: New Power: Spirit Away (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Spirit Away. power. Adds Threshold points to a mortal group already contributing points at a cost of 1 Might per point, or sends a character out of Faerie for 3 Might. [verb add; also needs dimension-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Arcadian Mysteries (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Arcadian Travel. ritual-or-art. A Merinita practitioner makes a charm with an Ease Factor 18 test, taking at least 10 minutes, to gain Threshold points equal to a stress die plus Perception, relevant Ability, and aura, and may bring up to a number of participants equal to Faerie Magic score. [verb add; also needs dimension-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Getting to Faerie (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Threshold. other. A point-based condition for entering Faerie, with required strength calculated as (13 − aura modifier) × 3. [verb block; also needs dimension-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Vitality and Fable in Faerie (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Fable points and fable score. other. Playing along with Faerie stories earns points that can boost a roll by the current score or raise that score at a cost of current score plus one points. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Becoming Faerie Through Fable (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie fable transformation. other. While in Faerie, a character can exchange Virtues for faerie ones according to fable score, with Major Virtues counting as three; the ordinary traits return outside Faerie. [verb transform; also needs body-form] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Mother Road (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Mother Road. other. A route through Faerie lets knowledgeable travelers cross vast distances, entering and exiting at trods by bargaining with a Guardian. [verb move; also needs portal-space] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Geographical Thresholds — Trods (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Trod. other. A Faerie-aura boundary worth at least 9 Threshold points that can lead into Faerie and connect layers within a Faerie regio. [verb move; also needs dimension-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Accrued Vis (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Accrued vis. other. Material glamour left when faeries end roles can preserve Pretenses or let an accepting faerie take up the relinquished role. [verb law: transfer; also needs power-transfer] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Sleeping Vis (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sleeping vis. other. Dormant material glamour without vitality may become a faerie when supplied with vitality, and sometimes awakens without it. [verb transform; also needs power-granting] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Abstract Vis (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Abstract vis. other. Glamour-marked matter imitates expected vis effects within its creator's demesne but cannot serve concrete magical crafting. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Environment and the Faerie Aura (ars-magica-realms#019); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie Realm aura. other. The realm has aura 10, granting most magi +5 while adding ten separately rolled botch dice to magical actions. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Passage 21, before “Creativity in the Faerie Realm” (ars-magica-realms#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Humanoid Faerie Virtue. feat-or-talent. It gives a character a faerie body, and gaining that body also requires acquiring a Traditional Ward. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Passage 21, before “Creativity in the Faerie Realm” (ars-magica-realms#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Lesser Benediction. feat-or-talent. A faerie can teach a character to reproduce one of its powers or Virtues through this lesser blessing. [verb copy] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Passage 21, before “Creativity in the Faerie Realm” (ars-magica-realms#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Greater Benediction. feat-or-talent. A faerie can teach a character to reproduce one of its powers or Virtues through this greater blessing. [verb copy] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Passage 21, before “Creativity in the Faerie Realm” (ars-magica-realms#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Lesser Charm. condition. This lesser Flaw may be acquired in exchange for learning an ability from a faerie. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Passage 21, before “Creativity in the Faerie Realm” (ars-magica-realms#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Greater Charm. condition. This greater Flaw may be acquired in exchange for learning an ability from a faerie. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Example of Arcadian Story Creation (ars-magica-realms#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wounded River. other. This river of blood hides the Stone Drum and is where Arduinna bathes to renew her Might. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Example of Arcadian Story Creation (ars-magica-realms#020); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Enchanted Priest. other. This captive priest is a story element the heroes are meant to free from a faerie’s grip. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Fast Might Recovery (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Fast Might Recovery. feat-or-talent. Refills the faerie’s entire spent Might pool in six hours instead of 24. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Feast of the Fae (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Feast of the Fae. feat-or-talent. Once per day, traditional human offerings restore 5 lost Might points. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Feast of the Dead (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Feast of the Dead. feat-or-talent. Draining a human’s long-term fatigue or causing at least a Medium Wound restores 2 Might points. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Increased Faerie Might (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Increased Faerie Might. feat-or-talent. Raises the faerie’s Might score by 5 as a Minor Virtue or 15 as a Major Virtue, and may be taken repeatedly with troupe approval. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Time or Place of Power (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Time or Place of Power. feat-or-talent. Raises the faerie’s Might by 10 at a chosen role-linked time or place, which a successful Intelligence plus Faerie Lore check against 9 can identify. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Decreased Might (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Decreased Might. feat-or-talent. Sets the faerie’s Might to 1 instead of the usual 5, but leaves powers without Might costs available. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Restricted Might (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Restricted Might. condition. Specified conditions end the faerie’s ongoing external supernatural effects and prevent it from spending or recovering Might while they last. [verb end] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Slow Might Recovery (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Slow Might Recovery. feat-or-talent. Restores only 1 Might point per day, except in a variant that restores the pool at a particular lunar phase. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Might Recovery Requires Vitality (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Might Recovery Requires Vitality. feat-or-talent. Requires eight hours of rest and a qualifying human-community meal or activity to restore at least 1 Might, or the adjusted Aura amount if greater. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Huge (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Huge. feat-or-talent. Increases a faerie’s Size and adjusts its Characteristics and body levels accordingly. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Little (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Little. feat-or-talent. Decreases a faerie’s Size and adjusts its Characteristics and body levels accordingly. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: External Vis (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: External Vis. feat-or-talent. Places the faerie’s essence in a portable role-related prop; destroying the prop collapses its body, while spending its vis kills it permanently. [verb bind; also needs item-bound-power] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Faerie Beast (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie Beast. feat-or-talent. Gives the faerie an animal appearance while retaining the advantages of a faerie body. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Faerie Speech (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Faerie Speech. feat-or-talent. Lets the faerie speak to listeners in a language they understand without spending Might, once it has heard them speak. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Humanoid Faerie (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Humanoid Faerie. feat-or-talent. Gives the faerie a material body of roughly human shape. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Hybrid Form (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hybrid Form. feat-or-talent. Gives the faerie a material body combining human and animal elements without a wholly humanoid structure. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Immune to (Source of Damage) (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Immune to (Source of Damage). feat-or-talent. Prevents damage from a chosen natural or magical force, with broader or common threats requiring the more costly version. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Puissant Pretense (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Puissant Pretense. feat-or-talent. Adds 2 to rolls using a single Pretense suited to the faerie’s form. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Residual Power (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Residual Power. feat-or-talent. Automatically triggers one of the faerie’s powers when its body is destroyed. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Intangible Flesh (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Intangible Flesh. condition. Makes the faerie immaterial and unable to physically affect the world. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Poor Combatant (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Poor Combatant. condition. Reduces Attack and Defense by 2 for one combat Pretense. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Reduced Damage (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Reduced Damage. condition. Reduces a natural weapon’s positive Damage score by 2. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Reduced Initiative (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Reduced Initiative. condition. Reduces a natural weapon’s positive Initiative score by 3. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Reduced Soak (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Reduced Soak. condition. Reduces positive Soak by 2 and may be selected multiple times. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Role Requires Suffering (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Role Requires Suffering. condition. Makes injuries painful and imposes the human-equivalent wound or fatigue penalties on Pretense use despite the faerie’s regeneration. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Vulnerable to (Substance) (ars-magica-realms#022); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Vulnerable to (Substance). condition. Sets the faerie’s Soak to 0 against a specified substance, which can also damage its glamour-made equipment. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Monstrous Appearance (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Monstrous Appearance. feat-or-talent. A frightening appearance imposes a −6 penalty in social situations where looks matter. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Negative Reaction (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Negative Reaction. feat-or-talent. A disturbing quality imposes a −3 penalty on social rolls. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Passes for Human (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Passes for Human. feat-or-talent. The faerie can appear human without social consequences, but cannot imitate prestigious human roles through this trait alone. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Positive Folktales (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Positive Folktales. feat-or-talent. When its faerie nature is obvious, local folklore leads others to treat it with respect and caution. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infiltrator (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Infiltrator. feat-or-talent. The faerie can live in a human role by paying the same character cost as that social status. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Virtues and Flaws Concerning Cognizance (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Incognizant. feat-or-talent. The faerie cannot knowingly seek role development, though assisting humans in stories may add Pretenses. [verb law: limit] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Virtues and Flaws Concerning Cognizance (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Narrowly Cognizant. feat-or-talent. The faerie can pursue self-improvement in ways traditional for its kind. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Virtues and Flaws Concerning Cognizance (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Highly Cognizant. feat-or-talent. The faerie understands that creative humans can change it and can seek such changes. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Traditional Ward (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Traditional Ward. feat-or-talent. A symbolic ward prevents touching and Might recovery nearby, while contact breaks down the faerie’s glamour and can destroy its body. [verb block; also needs body-code-decay] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Sovereign Ward (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sovereign Ward. feat-or-talent. A protected target cannot be harmed by the faerie, which must flee and is destroyed instantly if it touches the ward. [verb block; also needs concept-law] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Reputation as Confidence (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Reputation as Confidence. feat-or-talent. The faerie gets false Confidence points equal to its highest reputation, spends them on rolls supporting a reputation, and regains them as humans regain Confidence. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Reduced Power (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Reduced Power. feat-or-talent. This flaw removes five intricacy points, each making activation cost one more Might or Initiative one lower, subject to minimum and maximum limits. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Slow Power (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Slow Power. feat-or-talent. One chosen power requires an additional round of preparation before activation. [verb law: limit] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Greater and Lesser Faerie Powers — Loosely Material (ars-magica-realms#023); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Loosely Material. power. Lets an immaterial faerie form one of its specified bodies over a combat round, allocating five physical characteristic points per Might spent; it can maintain the body indefinitely and returns to immateriality in an uninterrupted round. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Focus Powers — Domestic Work (ars-magica-realms#024); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Domestic Work. power. Moves loose household objects and can kindle fires or boil water; thrown objects can injure, with attacks required to penetrate Magic Resistance. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Focus Powers — Father of Serpents (ars-magica-realms#024); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Father of Serpents. power. Reproduces eligible non-Ritual Creo, Intellego, Muto, or Rego effects concerning snakes, subject to motif limits. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Focus Powers — Shrinking (ars-magica-realms#024); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Shrinking. power. Changes the faerie to a chosen smaller size, applying the new size’s modifiers and simulating size-changing effects up to level 25. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Focus Powers — Smithying (ars-magica-realms#024); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Smithying. power. Reproduces eligible non-Ritual Creo, Muto, Rego, or Perdo effects concerning Terram, limited by the faerie’s motif. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Focus Powers — Miser’s Midas (ars-magica-realms#024); licence Ars Magica Open License
