note: Sense Passions — aura and spirit detection. feat-or-talent. At Ease Factor 6, detects an aura’s tarnish or temper and its type; it can also sense nearby invisible spirits and distinguish holy from unholy presence without identifying which is which. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: True Name of (Being) (ars-magica-realms#059); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: True Name of (Being). feat-or-talent. Studying the relevant Realm Lore until gaining 5 experience points reveals a being’s True Name, which lets the character affect it as if holding a permanent Arcane Connection. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Vituperation (ars-magica-realms#059); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Vituperation. condition. Infernal power can overwhelm an infernalist after major Warping gain or failed control, causing a potentially prolonged ordeal followed by an Aging roll with modified Warping Score added. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Sacrifice (ars-magica-realms#059); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ritual Sacrifice. ritual-or-art. An offering adds +2 for a target effigy, +4 for an animal, +6 for a black animal, +8 for a human, or +10 for an innocent human to the Infernal effect total. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Profaning the Holy (ars-magica-realms#059); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Profaning the Holy. ritual-or-art. Mystically spoils a holy object to produce typically 1 pawn of Form-appropriate Infernal vis, at a cost of 1 Confidence point unless a qualifying relic is used. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Characters with Demonic Blood (ars-magica-realms#059); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Demonic Blood. condition. A demon-blooded human is sterile and needs no food or drink, yet still experiences the urges of hunger, thirst, and reproduction. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Malachi, Devil Child — Powers (ars-magica-realms#059); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Free the Devil’s Servant. power. By touch after sunset, frees a demon trapped in an object, place, or person until dawn; a demon that wins permanent escape becomes Abrigor’s servant. [verb release; also needs spirit-contract-judgement] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Malachi, Devil Child — Powers (ars-magica-realms#059); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Obedient Slave. power. While concentrating, forces a person to carry out any task the user commands. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Malachi, Devil Child — Powers (ars-magica-realms#059); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Unbridled Emotion of the Masses. power. Imposes the user’s current emotion on as many as 100 targets, inclining them to act on it as though they had a +2 Personality Trait; repeated use improves control over the emotion expressed. [verb alter; also needs mind-state] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Unholy Powers — Diablerie (ars-magica-realms#060); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Infernal blessing. condition. A Forsaken supernatural grant that can persist until the recipient seeks redemption, but is lost on absolution and brings backlash when used for non-sinful ends. [verb add; also needs vow-cost] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Unholy Powers — Malediction (ars-magica-realms#060); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Infernal curse. condition. A usually Forsaken affliction that persists until dispelled, commonly through Divine agency or another Infernal Power. [verb bind; also needs containment-rule] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Goetic Arts — Ablating (ars-magica-realms#061); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ablating. power. Steals a spirit’s essence, permanently reducing its Might and letting the caster spend gained points on benefits such as healing, knowledge, power, or vis. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Goetic Arts — Binding (ars-magica-realms#061); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Binding. power. Forces a spirit into a person or object so it cannot leave, can use its Powers, and may provide benefits such as Magic Resistance or an anchor for effects. [verb bind; also needs protection-field, item-bound-power] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Goetic Arts — Commanding (ars-magica-realms#061); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Commanding. power. Compels a spirit to carry out an instruction, subject to task completion, the command’s expiry, and the spirit’s discretion in carrying it out. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Mythic Companion: The Diabolist (ars-magica-realms#061); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Diabolist. class-or-role. A person who enters an oath-bound relationship with a demon and receives Infernal blessings in exchange for service. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Goetic Arts (ars-magica-realms#061); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sorcerer. class-or-role. A practitioner who learns the four Goetic Arts as supernatural abilities and can use Penetration and ritual sacrifice to strengthen their effects. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Psychomachia (ars-magica-realms#061); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Psychomachia. other. An Infernal power domain for reading or controlling minds and emotions, while its failures can muddle or inflame the caster’s own passions. [verb alter; also needs mind-binding] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Mythic Companion: The Summoner (ars-magica-realms#062); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Summoner. class-or-role. A spirit-worker learns summoning from practice or a master and may command ghostly servants, often including a bound familiar or former master. [verb bind; also needs spirit-contract-judgement] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Mythic Companion: The Summoner — Required Virtues (ars-magica-realms#062); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Summoner. feat-or-talent. This required virtue identifies a character trained in summoning spirits. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — Apotropaic Mastery (ars-magica-realms#062); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Apotropaic Mastery. feat-or-talent. For eligible spells that directly affect Infernal Might, it adds Mastery Score multiplied by Hierarchy Score to the resulting effect level. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — Chthonic Magic (ars-magica-realms#062); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Chthonic Magic. feat-or-talent. This ability provides benefits in Magical and Infernal auras and with Infernal vis, and its further powers can require sinful acts while making magic detectable as unholy. [verb alter; also needs conceal-or-sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — Goetic Magic (ars-magica-realms#062); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Goetic Magic. ritual-or-art. A magus with the relevant Goetic Arts may substitute Rego for certain spirit Arts and Vim for Realm Lore when using those Arts. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — Goetic Mastery (ars-magica-realms#062); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Goetic Mastery. feat-or-talent. For a spell targeting a spirit, it adds a relevant Goetic Art to Casting Total and adjusts demon Penetration by five times the opposing Hierarchy Scores. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — False Magic (ars-magica-realms#062); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: False Gift. condition. This corrupted Gift makes learned supernatural abilities unholy to certain detection and causes Vituperation, not Twilight, under Warping. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — The Venatores (ars-magica-realms#062); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Venatores. class-or-role. These demon-hunting magi seek out demons and teach their methods through informal advanced apprenticeships. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 13: Infernal Traditions — Infernal Tradition: The Luciferans (ars-magica-realms#062); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Luciferans. class-or-role. This Infernal tradition favors Debauchery, Diablerie, Malediction, and Sense Passions. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Unknowing Evil (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Luciferan infernalist. class-or-role. A follower of Lucifer may mistake their infernal powers for holy counterparts, with some powers relabeled to preserve that mistaken belief. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infernal Tradition: Strigae (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Strigae. class-or-role. A demon-serving coven tradition whose members use maleficia for travel, attacks, and revenge, often gathering for night ceremonies. [verb law: summon; also needs dimension-travel, formation-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Benandanti (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Benandanti. class-or-role. Caul-born nightwalkers who fight stregoni in shared dream battles to protect their village and its harvest. [verb block; also needs protection-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Benandanti (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Strego. class-or-role. A male witch who leads a regional stregoni coven and directs its attacks and worship. [verb law: command] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infernal Tradition: The Witch-Hammers (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Witch-Hammers. class-or-role. A tradition of infernalists who use purportedly holy methods to force confessions and banish supernatural beings. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Orléans Heretics (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Orléans heretics. class-or-role. A group accused of rejecting Church sacraments and doctrine, whose alleged rites involved consuming preserved ashes to gain visions and instant travel. [verb move; also needs dimension-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infernal Tradition: Dark Gnostics (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Dark Gnostics. class-or-role. Infernalist sectarians who teach that sinful acts have moral value and use maleficia to seek insight into the world. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infernal Tradition: Dark Gnostics (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ophites. class-or-role. A Gnostic sect that venerates the Eden serpent and treats original sin as permission to pursue worldly pleasures. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infernal Tradition: Dark Gnostics (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Brethren of the Free Spirit. class-or-role. A heretical movement whose members treat personal desires as divine guidance and indulge them as religious devotion. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infernal Tradition: The Dread Host (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Dread Host. class-or-role. An infernal tradition that binds spirits to people and objects, seeking power and a place in Hell’s hierarchy after death. [verb bind; also needs item-bound-power] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infernal Tradition: The Mulhidun (ars-magica-realms#063); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Mulhidun. class-or-role. A feared tradition of devil-worshipers who regard their shaitan as the world’s true ruler and God as its maker rather than its warrior. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Ogam Writing (ars-magica-realms#064); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ogam writing. other. A system of short strokes across a vertical line used by the Damhadh-Duidsan to inscribe incantations, requiring Language 2 to sound out. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)
